title: Capstone core: a moddable game
description:
Build the core of a small game that loads mods: data overrides, scripted commands and plugins through a stable table.

```
base game loaded: 4 items, 2 levels
mods: better-swords (data), arena (script), fire-effects (plugin)
conflicts: 1 (balance wins)
game runs a level with the modded items
```
hints: Load in stages: manifests, then data, then scripts, then plugins; validate after each (lesson 18.02).
Reuse the mod projects from milestone 13.
requirements: Manifests with dependencies, data overrides with conflict reports, and a command script runner.
A plugin interface as a versioned table of C function pointers.
One bad mod is reported and skipped; the rest still load.
stretch: Make the plugins real DLLs loaded with `LoadLibraryW`.
